messages.content:
You are a senior engineering career coach specializing in crafting impactful resume bullet points for software engineers.

Analyze the following engineering activity data and generate 5-8 strong resume bullet points.

Role: backend
Date Range: 2026-05-09 to 2026-11-09

Activity Data:
- Commits: 292 (across 5 repositories)
- Pull Requests Merged: 106
- Code Reviews Completed: 65
- Top Repositories: acme/platform-infra, acme/search-api, alice/dotfiles, acme/checkout-service, acme/web-app

Sample Commits (showing work themes):
- [alice/dotfiles] fix: split monolith billing module
- [acme/web-app] test: remove dead feature flags
- [acme/checkout-service] feat: upgrade node base image
- [alice/dotfiles] chore: split monolith billing module
- [alice/dotfiles] refactor: add pagination to orders API
- [acme/platform-infra] feat: add retry to payment webhook handler
- [acme/platform-infra] feat: instrument checkout funnel with opentelemetry
- [alice/dotfiles] docs: add terraform module for read replicas
- [acme/search-api] test: cache product search results in redis
- [acme/search-api] chore: reduce p95 latency of /cart endpoint
- [acme/search-api] chore: migrate checkout form to react-hook-form
- [acme/platform-infra] test: migrate checkout form to react-hook-form
- [alice/dotfiles] fix: add terraform module for read replicas

- [acme/checkout-service] docs: reduce p95 latency of /cart endpoint
- [acme/platform-infra] perf: reduce p95 latency of /cart endpoint
- [acme/platform-infra] feat: add pagination to orders API
- [acme/search-api] chore: improve error messages on login

Sample PRs:

- [acme/web-app] PR #5063 (CLOSED)

- [acme/checkout-service] PR #5062 (CLOSED)
- [acme/search-api] PR #5061 (CLOSED)

- [acme/web-app] PR #5059 (CLOSED)
- [acme/checkout-service] PR #5058 (CLOSED)
- [acme/checkout-service] PR #5057 (CLOSED)
- [acme/search-api] Web: accessible checkout form (MERGED)
- [acme/platform-infra] PR #5056 (CLOSED)
- [acme/platform-infra] Fix flaky inventory reservation test (CLOSED)
- [alice/dotfiles] Infra: read replica for reporting DB (MERGED)
- [acme/checkout-service] PR #5055 (CLOSED)
- [acme/platform-infra] PR #5054 (CLOSED)

Guidelines:
1. Group achievements by theme (performance, reliability, features, collaboration)
2. Use STAR format implicitly (Situation, Task, Action, Result)
3. Quantify where possible (e.g., "reduced latency by ~30%", "shipped 12 features")
4. Tailor language to the backend role
5. Use strong action verbs
6. Each bullet should demonstrate clear impact

Respond in JSON format:
{
  "bullets": [
    {
      "text": "The resume bullet point",
      "category": "performance|reliability|features|collaboration|leadership",
      "impact": "Brief description of measurable impact"
    }
  ]
}
